description: Rishta Lentil Noodles Lebanese is a heartwarming and traditional Middle Eastern dish that combines tender lentils with pasta noodles. This wholesome meal offers a delightful blend of earthy flavors, brightened by a tangy garlic-cilantro dressing and crispy fried onions. It is a comforting staple perfect for any family gathering.

ingredients.item: Wide egg noodles or homemade pasta sheets

instructions.title: Cook the Lentils
instructions.text: Rinse the lentils thoroughly. In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 6 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Drain any excess water, reserving about 1 cup of the cooking liquid.

instructions.title: Prepare the Onions
instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized and crispy. This may take 15-20 minutes. Remove half of the crispy onions and set aside for garnish.

instructions.title: Sauté Garlic and Cilantro
instructions.text: To the same skillet with the remaining onions, add the minced garlic and chopped fresh cilantro. Sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant, being careful not to burn the garlic. This aromatic mixture will form the heart of the Rishta flavor.

instructions.title: Cook the Noodles
instructions.text: Bring a separate pot of salted water to a boil. Add the cut pasta noodles and cook according to package instructions until al dente. If using homemade pasta, cook until tender, typically 3-5 minutes. Drain well.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Add the cooked lentils and drained pasta noodles to the skillet with the garlic-cilantro-onion mixture. Pour in the reserved lentil cooking liquid (or fresh water/broth if preferred). Stir gently to combine all ingredients. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Bring to a gentle simmer for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld and the noodles to absorb some of the liquid.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Stir in the fresh lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Ladle the Rishta Lentil Noodles into serving bowls. Garnish generously with the reserved crispy fried onions and a sprinkle of sumac, if using. Serve hot with a side of fresh salad or pickled vegetables.

tips: For extra rich flavor, fry the onions slowly over medium-low heat until they are very dark brown and crispy, almost burnt, but not quite. This caramelization is key.
If you prefer a thicker consistency, add less reserved lentil liquid. For a more soupy dish, add more. Adjust to your liking.
Rishta tastes even better the next day as the flavors continue to develop. Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
